name: La Reserve Paris
positioning: La Reserve Paris - Hotel and Spa: a mansion built in 1854 for the Duc de Morny, redesigned by Jacques Garcia and opened as La Reserve in 2015, at 42 Avenue Gabriel just off the Champs-Elysees
best_for: Travelers who want a base between Avenue Montaigne and Rue du Faubourg St-Honore
Families who need connecting rooms and children's extras on request
Guests who want a spa whose pool is reserved for hotel guests, private lessons and spa members

facts.text: The hotel is at 42 Avenue Gabriel, midway between Avenue Montaigne and Rue du Faubourg St-Honore, a stone's throw from the Champs-Elysees.
The hotel overlooks the Eiffel Tower, the Pantheon, the Grand Palais and the Concorde obelisk.
The building was built in 1854 as a private residence for the Duc de Morny, Napoleon III's half-brother.
Under Michel Reybier's ownership and after a redesign overseen by Jacques Garcia, it opened as La Reserve in 2015.
Le Gabriel serves the cuisine of chef Jerome Banctel.
La Pagode offers French cuisine that highlights brasserie-inspired dishes.
Bar Le Gaspard suits a business meeting, an after-work get-together, cocktails or a glass of champagne.
La Pagode uses the inner courtyard, and Le Gaspard the streetside area in front of the hotel.
Spa Nescens has an indoor pool, a hammam, a fitness studio and treatment rooms.
Hairdressing (cut and blow-dry) can be provided in your room.
The entire hotel is wheelchair-accessible, with two Prestige Junior Suite rooms designed for guests with reduced mobility.
A significant proportion of the rooms and suites can be connected.

highlights.text: The book-lined Duc de Morny Library has remained much as it was since the 2015 opening.
In the rooms, the furniture is by Henryot, the silk wallpaper by Rubelli and the fabric headboards by Prelle.
The concierge can arrange an after-hours visit to Marie-Antoinette's boudoir at Versailles or a helicopter day trip to Champagne.
Nescens is a Swiss brand whose products are sold exclusively by the spa at La Reserve Paris.
For children, tipis, rocking horses, and popcorn and cotton-candy machines are available on request.

considerations.text: The hotel has no kids' club.
The spa has just three treatment rooms.
There is no formal reception; the Louis XV Salon serves that purpose.
